data.long_description:
Experience sophisticated city living in this stylish 2-bedroom apartment located in Forte 1, within the heart of Downtown Dubai. Spanning 1,111.05 sq ft, this residence offers a thoughtfully designed layout with modern finishes, bright interiors, and a seamless blend of comfort and elegance—perfect for end-users or investors seeking a prime urban address.

Property Amenities:

2 spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
2 modern bathrooms with premium fittings
Bright open-plan living and dining area
Fully fitted contemporary kitchen
Floor-to-ceiling windows providing natural light
Balcony with city views (subject to layout)
Central air conditioning
Covered parking

Building Features:

Swimming pool
Fully equipped gym
Residents’ lounge and leisure areas
24/7 security and concierge services
High-speed elevators
Elegant lobby and common areas

Location Highlights:

Located in Forte Tower 1, part of the prestigious Opera District Forte Tower 1
Walking distance to Dubai Opera and Burj Khalifa
Close to The Dubai Mall and Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Business Bay
Surrounded by world-class dining, entertainment, and cultural attractions
Prime central location in Dubai’s most iconic district
data.title: 2 bedroom apartment to rent
